newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SKF says could sell FlexLink subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: SKF says could sell FlexLink subsidiary.

text.p: Swedish roller bearing company SKF AB said on Monday it might sell its subsidiary FlexLink Systems AB, which develops and sells conveyor belts that transport goods between different machines.
"FlexLink is outside our core areas of bearings and seals," SKF spokesman Ake Svanberg told Reuters.

"We have probed possibilities for a sale to concentrate SKF to core operations. We have noticed an external interest for the company and we are always interested in business...But nothing is decided yet."
FlexLink, which is one of SKF's most profitable and fast growing subsidiaries, has about 230 staff and an annual turnover of 600 million crowns.
